site.name: Zyventa
site.heroSubheadline: We provide world-class support to those who want to enter the most promising markets of Middle East & North Africa, with the help of the most dynamic management team. We recognize that our team is what makes us who we are.
site.address: Office No. 323, 3rd Floor, Al Rehan Block, Omniyat Building, Al Mamzar, Dubai, UAE
site.aboutText: ZYVENTA was founded to serve as a link between international healthcare companies and the growing markets of Arabian Gulf and the Middle East. ZYVENTA bridges access gaps by partnering with global pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies to deploy and commercialize new pharmaceutical, biologics, and other healthcare solutions in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) markets.
site.aboutSubtext: At ZYVENTA, we pride ourselves on our comprehensive approach to establishing and enhancing brand presence within the region's dynamic healthcare landscape. Our dedicated team oversees every phase and process necessary to cultivate a strong brand identity and market presence. With meticulous attention to detail, we integrate five essential divisions: Business Development, Regulation, Marketing, Sales and Distribution.
site.mission: To be the preferred regional partner for pharma companies entering MENA, and to develop our own branded products that improve patients’ health and quality of life.
site.vision: A specialty firm introducing innovative products that meet unmet medical needs across MENA.
site.footerDescription: We serve as a link between international healthcare companies and GCC and the growing markets of the Middle East.

products.name: Zyvenkar
products.tagline: Controls BP and future complications too
products.description: Experience the combined benefits of Amlodipine and Olmesartan with Zyvenkar, a convenient dual-action tablet designed to support effective blood-pressure control. Two complementary ingredients work together in one simple treatment option for hypertension management.
products.features:
1. Dual-action antihypertensive combination
2. Combines Amlodipine and Olmesartan in one tablet
3. Available in four strength combinations
4. Film-coated tablets
5. Convenient combination therapy for hypertension management
products.usage: Zyvenkar should be taken as directed by a healthcare professional. The appropriate strength and treatment regimen should be determined according to the individual patient's clinical requirements and blood-pressure response.
products.closingLine: Two complementary actions. One convenient tablet.

products.name: Desvenzyl
products.tagline: A modern SNRI for effective depression management
products.description: Discover dependable support for depression management with Desvenzyl Extended-Release Tablets. Designed for sustained release, Desvenzyl offers convenient once-daily therapy to support mood and emotional well-being in adults with major depressive disorder.
products.features:
1. Desvenlafaxine extended-release formulation
2. Available in 50 mg and 100 mg strengths
3. Convenient once-daily dosing, as prescribed
4. Designed for sustained release of the active ingredient
products.usage:
Desvenzyl should be taken exactly as prescribed by a healthcare professional.

Extended-release tablets should generally be swallowed whole and should not be crushed, chewed, or divided unless specifically advised by a healthcare professional.
products.closingLine: Reliable extended-release therapy for everyday treatment continuity.

products.name: Lacolep
products.description: Experience focused seizure-management support with Lacolep Film-Coated Tablets. Formulated with Lacosamide for precise dosing, Lacolep provides a convenient and reliable option for individualized antiepileptic therapy.
products.features:
1. Lacosamide anticonvulsant therapy
2. Available in 50 mg and 100 mg strengths
3. Film-coated tablets
4. Precise and convenient oral dosing
5. Suitable for use as part of an individualized epilepsy-management regimen
products.usage: Lacolep should be taken exactly as prescribed by a healthcare professional. The dosage and frequency of administration depend on factors such as the patient's age, clinical condition, response to treatment, and whether Lacosamide is being used alone or alongside other antiepileptic medicines.
products.closingLine: Precision dosing to support confident seizure management.

products.name: Febuvent
products.description: Discover effective uric-acid management with Febuvent Tablets. Formulated with Febuxostat, Febuvent helps lower elevated uric acid levels and supports the long-term management of hyperuricemia associated with gout.
products.features:
1. prevent accumulation/recrytallization of uric acid in joints.
2.Xanthine oxidase inhibitor
3. Helps reduce elevated serum uric acid levels
4. Available in 40 mg and 80 mg strengths
5. Convenient oral tablet formulation
products.usage:
Febuvent should be taken exactly as prescribed by a healthcare professional.

The appropriate dose should be determined based on the patient's clinical condition, serum uric acid levels, renal function, treatment response, and applicable prescribing guidance.
products.closingLine: Keep uric acid under control with dependable daily therapy.

products.name: Akthyod
products.description: Introducing Akthyod Tablets, formulated with Carbimazole to support effective management of an overactive thyroid. Available in two strengths, Akthyod offers flexible treatment options tailored to individual thyroid-care needs.
products.features:
1. Longer intrathyroidal levels
2. Carbimazole antithyroid therapy
3. Available in 5 mg and 20 mg strengths
4. Helps reduce excessive thyroid hormone production
5. Supports individualized treatment according to thyroid function
6. Convenient 100-tablet pack
products.usage:
Akthyod should be taken exactly as prescribed by a healthcare professional.

The dose is individualized according to thyroid function tests and the patient's response to treatment. Regular monitoring of thyroid hormone levels is important during therapy.
products.closingLine: Flexible strengths for effective thyroid management.

products.name: Nourisil MD
products.tagline: The gold standard for scar management
products.composition: Medical-grade blend of five silicones + Vitamin E
products.description: Discover advanced scar care with Nourisil MD, an ultra-light and transparent silicone gel designed to improve the appearance of new and old scars. Its smooth, self-drying formula helps soften and flatten scars while fitting effortlessly into everyday skincare routines.
products.features:
1. Helps flatten, soften and smooth scars
2. Helps reduce scar-associated redness
3. Helps relieve itching and discomfort associated with scars
4. Transparent and self-drying formulation
5. Lightweight, silky and non-greasy feel
6. Forms a protective, hydrating silicone layer
7. Suitable for application on areas including the face and joints
8. Suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin
9. Preservative-free and mineral-oil-free
products.usage:
Wash your hands and ensure the scar area is clean and dry.

Apply a small amount of Nourisil™ MD to the scar.

Gently massage the gel over the affected area.

Allow the gel to dry completely.

Once dry, sunscreen or cosmetics may be applied over the area.

Apply twice daily — once in the morning and once at night.
products.closingLine: Professional scar care designed for everyday confidence.

products.name: Nevral
products.composition: Quercetin, Alpha Lipoic Acid, Carnitine, Folic Acid, Vitamin B12, Vitamin B1
products.description: Support healthier nerve function with Nevral, a carefully selected blend of antioxidants, amino-acid derivatives and essential B vitamins. Its comprehensive formula is designed to support peripheral nerve health, cellular energy and everyday nervous-system function.
products.features:
1. Supports normal nerve function
2. Provides antioxidant support
3. Helps support peripheral nerve health
4. Contains Alpha Lipoic Acid and Quercetin
5. Provides essential B vitamins involved in nervous-system function
6. Convenient once-daily tablet formulation
products.usage: 1 tablet daily, preferably during the main meal, or as directed by a healthcare professional.
products.closingLine: Everyday nutritional support for healthier nerve function.

products.name: Calmi Relax
products.tagline: Your power is proportional to your ability to relax
products.composition: Valerian Extract, Golden Root, Hawthorn, Passiflora incarnata, Magnesium Citrate
products.description: Experience a calmer, more balanced day with Calmi Relax. This unique combination of standardized botanical extracts and magnesium is designed to support relaxation, emotional balance and normal nervous-system function during times of everyday stress.
products.features:
1. Combination of herbal extracts and magnesium
2. Contains Valerian, Rhodiola, Hawthorn and Passiflora
3. Standardized botanical extracts
4. Supports the central nervous system
5. Convenient tablet formulation
products.closingLine: A balanced botanical formula for calmer, more relaxed days.

products.name: Calmi Dormin
products.tagline: A good night's sleep is the pillar of health
products.composition: Valerian Extract 250 mg, Lemon Balm Extract 200 mg, Linden Flower Extract 150 mg
products.description: Welcome more restful nights with Calmi Dormin. Combining Valerian, Lemon Balm and Linden Flower extracts, this carefully crafted formula supports relaxation and helps create a calmer, more comfortable bedtime routine.
products.features:
1. Combination of three standardized botanical extracts
2. Contains Valerian, Lemon Balm and Linden Flower
3. Provides 250 mg Valerian Extract per tablet
4. Standardized concentrations of key botanical constituents
5. Convenient oral tablet formulation
products.usage: Take 1 to 2 tablets per day, or as recommended by a healthcare professional.
products.closingLine: Unwind naturally and support a more restful night.

products.name: Calmivenal Gel
products.tagline: Simple solution for a delicate problem
products.composition: Diosmin, Hesperidin, Oak Bark Extract, Carbomer 940
products.description: Discover targeted comfort with Calmivenal Gel, specially formulated for local haemorrhoid care. Its soothing combination of ingredients helps relieve irritation, itching, burning, swelling and discomfort while supporting recovery of sensitive skin in the affected area.
products.features:
1. Helps relieve itching and burning
2. Helps soothe irritation and discomfort
3. Helps reduce swelling associated with haemorrhoids
4. Supports recovery of irritated skin and mucous membranes
5. Combination of flavonoids and botanical components
6. Designed specifically for application in the anal area
products.usage:
Apply Calmivenal Gel to the affected anal area according to the instructions provided with the product or as advised by a healthcare professional.

The area should be cleaned gently before application.
products.closingLine: Soothing local care where comfort matters most.

products.name: Troximetacin Gel
products.description: Experience targeted relief with Troximetacin Gel, a dual-action topical formula combining Indomethacin and Troxerutin. Designed for joint and muscle discomfort, it helps relieve pain, inflammation and localized swelling where you need it most.
products.features:
1. Dual-action combination of Indomethacin and Troxerutin
2. Helps relieve localized pain and inflammation
3. Helps reduce swelling
4. Designed for targeted topical application
5. Suitable for musculoskeletal and orthopedic care
products.usage:
Apply a suitable amount of Troximetacin Gel to the affected area and gently massage into the skin, according to the product leaflet or as directed by a healthcare professional.

Wash hands after application unless the hands are the area being treated.
products.closingLine: Targeted relief that goes straight to the area of discomfort.

products.name: Breezex
products.tagline: Cooling hydrogel pain relief that lasts up to 8 hours
products.description: Enjoy cooling, mess-free pain relief with Breezex Hydrogel Patches. Formulated with 6.5% Menthol, Breezex delivers a refreshing cooling sensation directly to areas of minor muscle and musculoskeletal discomfort, with comfortable wear for up to 8 hours.
products.features:
1. 6.5% Menthol cooling formulation
2. Provides targeted cooling pain relief
3. Lasts for up to 8 hours
4. Deep-penetrating cooling sensation
5. Comfortable and breathable
6. Stays securely in place
7. Soft and flexible
8. Mess-free application
9. Can be worn discreetly under clothing
10. Can be cut to the desired size
11. Convenient ready-to-use hydrogel patch
products.usage:
Open the pouch and remove the patch.

Peel away the protective film.

Apply the adhesive side directly to the affected area.

Ensure the patch is positioned securely on clean, dry skin.
products.closingLine: Cool, comfortable relief that stays with you.

products.name: Zyflex
products.tagline: Long-lasting patch relief for muscle pain and stiffness
products.composition: Wintergreen Oil 7%, Menthol 7%, Camphor 7%, Eucalyptus Oil 1%, Clove Oil 1%
products.description: Experience long-lasting relief with Zyflex Patches. Its powerful combination of natural ingredients provides targeted support for backache, joint pain, muscle pain and stiffness for up to 12 hours.
products.features:
1. Provides targeted topical pain relief
2. Effective for up to 12 hours
3. Helps relieve muscle pain and stiffness
4. Suitable for joint and back discomfort
5. Sweatproof and waterproof
6. Designed to adhere securely to the skin
7. Convenient patch format
8. Clinically tested, as stated on the product packaging
products.usage:
Remove the patch from the pouch.

Pull the transparent release film away from the patch to expose a small adhesive section in the center.

Place the exposed adhesive area onto the affected part of the body.

Pull away the remaining release film completely.

Gently press the edges of the patch to ensure secure adhesion.
products.closingLine: Powerful multi-ingredient relief for active days.

products.name: Zynatis
products.description: Discover focused local pain relief with Zynatis Lidocaine 4% Patch. Designed to deliver Lidocaine directly to the affected area, Zynatis helps temporarily numb localized discomfort in a clean, convenient patch format that can be worn for up to 12 hours.
products.features:
1. Contains Lidocaine 4%
2. Provides targeted local pain relief
3. Temporarily numbs the affected area
4. Convenient adhesive patch format
5. Direct application to the area of discomfort
6. Can be worn for up to 12 hours
7. Available in 5-patch and 10-patch packs
8. Large 10 cm × 14 cm patch size for convenient coverage
products.usage:
1. Clean and dry the affected area.
2. Remove the protective film from the patch.
3. Apply the sticky side directly onto the skin over the affected area.
4. Apply one patch at a time to the affected area.
5. Remove the patch after a maximum application period of 12 hours.
products.closingLine: Focused relief, exactly where you need it.

products.name: Zybitel
products.description: Experience the convenience of two antihypertensive agents in one tablet with Zybitel. Combining Telmisartan and Amlodipine, Zybitel provides complementary action to support effective blood-pressure control in patients who require combination therapy.
products.features:
1. Fixed-dose combination of Telmisartan + Amlodipine
2. Dual-mechanism antihypertensive therapy
3. Available in 80/5 mg and 80/10 mg strengths
4. Metabolically neutral safe inn diabetes paitents
5. Convenient single-tablet combination
6. Suitable for individualized hypertension management
products.usage:
Zybitel should be taken exactly as prescribed by a healthcare professional.

Telmisartan/Amlodipine combination tablets are generally administered once daily, with or without food. The dose should be individualized according to the patient's blood-pressure response, previous therapy and clinical condition.
products.closingLine: Dual-action cardiovascular support in one convenient dose.

products.name: Vildagard
products.description: Discover convenient dual-action support for type 2 diabetes management with Vildagard. Combining Vildagliptin and Metformin, Vildagard works through complementary mechanisms to help improve blood-glucose control, with multiple strengths to suit individual treatment needs.
products.features:
1. Enhances glycemic control with 1.1% HbA1c reduction
2. addresses key underlying defects of type 2 diabites
3. associated with low rissk of hypoglycemia and weight neutality
4. Fixed-dose combination of Vildagliptin + Metformin
5. Dual-mechanism approach to blood-glucose management
6.cAvailable in three strengths
7. Film-coated tablet formulation
8. Convenient combination therapy
9. 60-tablet pack
products.usage:
Vildagard should be taken exactly as prescribed by a healthcare professional.

The dose should be individualized according to the patient's current treatment, blood-glucose control, kidney function and tolerability. Vildagliptin/Metformin combinations are commonly administered with food to help reduce gastrointestinal effects associated with Metformin. The recommended maximum daily dose of Vildagliptin is generally 100 mg.
products.closingLine: Two complementary mechanisms for confident glucose management.

products.name: Telmijub
products.description: Experience dependable blood-pressure management with Telmijub. Formulated with Telmisartan, this once-daily tablet helps relax blood vessels and support effective, long-term control of hypertension in a simple and convenient format.
products.features:
1. Contains Telmisartan
2. Angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB)
3. Helps manage high blood pressure
4. Available in 40 mg and 80 mg strengths
5. Convenient oral tablet formulation
6. 30-tablet pack
products.usage:
Telmijub should be taken exactly as prescribed by a healthcare professional.

For hypertension, the commonly effective Telmisartan dose is 40 mg once daily. In patients whose blood pressure is not adequately controlled, the dose may be increased to 80 mg once daily, depending on clinical response and medical advice.
products.closingLine: Simple once-daily support for long-term blood-pressure control.

faqs.question: What regions does Zyventa serve?
faqs.answer: ZYVENTA serves the Arabian Gulf (GCC) countries and the broader Middle East and North Africa (MENA) markets, connecting international healthcare brands with regional distributors, pharmacies, and healthcare systems.

faqs.question: What services does Zyventa offer?
faqs.answer: Zyventa integrates five core divisions: Business Development & Partnerships, Regulatory Affairs & Compliance, Strategic Marketing, Medical Sales Detailing, and Seamless Wholesale & Retail Distribution.

faqs.question: How does Zyventa ensure compliance with regulatory requirements?
faqs.answer: Our in-house regulatory team closely coordinates with regional health authorities including MOHAP (UAE) and other GCC bodies to manage product dossiers, fast-track registration, and maintain rigorous pharmacovigilance standards.

faqs.question: What sets Zyventa's marketing strategies apart?
faqs.answer: Our marketing team combines traditional on-site detailing and medical education with innovative digital marketing strategies, creating comprehensive demand generation from concept to customer.

faqs.question: How does Zyventa manage its distribution network?
faqs.answer: We supply hospitals, government bodies, retail pharmacy chains and online channels through Zyventa Trading, our MOH-approved Bait Al Mas drug store, and a network of licensed local distributors. Stock is held at two warehouse locations: Bait Al Mas Drug Store LLC, Abu Shagara, Sharjah, UAE, and Zyventa Biocare, Al Qusais 4, Dubai, UAE.

blogs.author: The Zyventa Team
blogs.excerpt: In today's ever-evolving healthcare landscape, the importance of effective medicine distribution and online selling cannot be overstated. As a leading player in this field, Zyventa has positioned itself as a vital link between international healthcare companies and the burgeoning markets of the Arabian Gulf and the Middle East.
content: In today's ever-evolving healthcare landscape, the importance of effective medicine distribution and online selling cannot be overstated. As a leading player in this field, Zyventa has positioned itself as a vital link between international healthcare companies and the burgeoning markets of the Arabian Gulf and the Middle East. With a firm commitment to bridging access gaps and promoting innovative healthcare solutions, Zyventa's role goes far beyond simply distributing medications. Therefore, it's about facilitating change and improving lives.

ZYVENTA was founded to serve as a link between international healthcare companies and the growing markets of Arabian Gulf and the Middle East. ZYVENTA bridges access gaps by partnering with global pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies to deploy and commercialize new pharmaceutical, biologics, and other healthcare solutions in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) markets.
We recognize that our team is what makes us who we are. We pride ourselves on our professional, highly skilled and dedicated staff, each bringing their own unique skills to the business.
